language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the TeleDrive interface, menus, and notifications.
language.cardDescription: Select your preferred language. Changes apply immediately across the application.
language.callout: Instant Sync: TeleDrive preserves your language choice locally and automatically applies it across all windows and sessions.

logout.title: Log Out
logout.description: You will be signed out of your Telegram account. Your files will remain safe in your storage channel.

account.title: Telegram Account
account.description: Manage your connected Telegram credentials and cloud storage channel.

notConnected.title: Not connected
notConnected.description: Connect your Telegram account to start storing unlimited files in your private storage channel.

channel.title: Active Storage Channel
channel.description: Your files, folders, and metadata are persisted securely in this private channel.
channel.name: Channel Name

account.architecture: Decentralized cloud storage: Your files are uploaded as message documents directly to your private Telegram channel. TeleDrive maintains an indexed manifest pinned in this channel so your folders and files stay synchronized automatically.

switchDialog.title: Switch Storage Channel
switchDialog.description: Select a different private Telegram channel to use for TeleDrive files.
switchDialog.warning: Warning: Switching storage channels resets the local cache. TeleDrive will look for an existing manifest in the selected channel or create a new one.

toasts.alreadyUpToDate: Your drive is already up to date.
toasts.channelReset: Storage channel reset. Restart the app to re-map it.

backup.title: Device Backup
backup.description: Pick folders on this computer to automatically mirror to your private Telegram storage channel.

folders.title: Source folders
folders.description: Folders are mirrored under your device backup root and kept in sync. Saves automatically.
folders.empty: No folders added yet. Click “Add folder” below.
folders.pickerTitle: Pick a folder to back up

excludes.title: Exclude patterns
excludes.description: Glob patterns relative to a source folder. Supports *, **, and ?. Examples: node_modules, *.tmp.
excludes.empty: No excludes. Everything in your source folders will be backed up.

cadence.title: Backup cadence
cadence.description: How often TeleDrive should re-scan your source folders. Only changed files are re-uploaded.

backup.missingRoots_one: {{count}} source folder is unavailable. Other folders were backed up.
backup.missingRoots_other: {{count}} source folders are unavailable. Other folders were backed up.
backup.progressHint: See the progress panel in the bottom-right corner.
backup.howItWorks: How backup works: TeleDrive walks the folders you pick, diffs against a local manifest, and uploads only new or changed files.

toasts.noFolders: Pick at least one source folder first

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize the layout appearance and color theme of TeleDrive.

themeMode.title: Theme Mode
themeMode.description: Choose whether TeleDrive uses light, dark, or system-adaptive appearance.

light.label: Light
light.description: Clean, high-contrast light theme with Google Drive canvas

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Sleek dark theme optimized for low-light environments

system.label: System
system.description: Automatically syncs with your operating system appearance

appearance.callout: Theme Synchronization: TeleDrive uses Google Drive's curated HSL color tokens across both light (`#F8FAFD`) and dark (`#131314`) surfaces, ensuring high contrast and reduced eye strain.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Monitor your Telegram cloud storage space, active files, and trash retention.

indexSave.saving: Saving the updated file list to Telegram…
indexSave.retrying: Telegram is rate limiting the file-list save. Retrying automatically in {{seconds}}s. Your files are safe.

info.noLimit: Telegram does not impose any limit on the cumulative volume of data stored in private channels.
info.fileLimits: Individual file limits: up to 2 GB per single file for standard accounts, and up to 4 GB for Telegram Premium subscribers.

toasts.indexIncomplete: Couldn't verify a complete index. Cached files are still shown; changes stay paused until the index is repaired.

recovery.title: Recover files
recovery.description: Find files missing from your drive by checking older index snapshots and the uploaded files in your channel. Your current files stay exactly as they are; recovered files are added alongside them.
recovery.warning: Recovered files are added to your current drive — nothing is removed. Older snapshots may include files you later deleted or renamed. Files whose Telegram message is missing will be skipped.
recovery.restoredPartial_one: Added {{count}} file; {{skipped}} missing message was skipped
recovery.restoredPartial_other: Added {{count}} files; {{skipped}} missing messages were skipped
recovery.nothingNew: Nothing new to add — those files are already in your drive.

about.title: About TeleDrive
about.description: Learn more about the application, updates, and open-source project.
about.tagline: Virtual cloud storage client backed by Telegram
about.summary: TeleDrive is an open-source, cross-platform cloud drive client powered by Telegram. It maps your file storage to a private Telegram channel and organizes your files into a virtual hierarchical drive with fast search, preview, and real-time synchronization.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: TeleDrive is an independent open-source client application and is not affiliated with, authorized, maintained, sponsored or endorsed by Telegram FZ-LLC or any of its affiliates.

toasts.latestVersion: TeleDrive v{{version}} is the latest version.
